s: Din met beyom tob ubo k"b seipim: met hammuttal leqobro, im hu yom tob rishon — lo yitasseq bo yisrael, apillu met qodem yom tob sheim yashhu oto ad haereb yasriach, vegam i epshar leqobro bo bayyom al yede nokri — ap al pi ken en mitzvat aseh shel qebura docha et lo taaseh vaaseh shel yom tob.

Abal muttar leqobro al yede nokri, apillu met bo bayyom sheepshar lehashhoto ad haereb velo yasriach kelal — ap al pi ken asur lehashhoto ad haereb kede sheyyitassequ bo yisrael, ella meqabberin oto miyyad al yede nokri.

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bimlakot gemurot haasurot min hattora, kegon letaqqen lo qeber vearon vetakrikin, veken lekassoto beapar leachar shessamuhu betok haqqeber, shehassotem guma beapar chayyab mishshum boneh kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"b. Abal debarim sheenan asurim ella middibre soperim, kegon letaltelo kede lehalbisho ukede letaharo ulesumo baqqeber — muttar al yede yisrael. Veken muttar lehachem lo mayim al yede yisrael kede letaharo, veken muttar lehotzio al yede yisrael apillu derek reshut harabbim, demittok shehuttera habara vehotzaa letzorek akila — muttar apillu shello letzorek akila im yesh bahem tzorek hayyom, kegon letzorek qeburat hammet shehi mitzva shezzemanna bo bayyom. Vetob lizzaher letaharo al gabbe or o al gabbe neser, vitaharu oto beqash veteben o beyadayim, abal lo yetaharu oto bisdinim, shello yabou lide sechita.

Im bemaqom shemmuttal sham hammet en sham bet haqqebarot vetzarik leholiko lemaqom acher rachoq beinyan shello yukelu lehaggia lesham bo bayyom, ulemachar hu shabbat shei epshar leholiko kelal apillu al yede nokri kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"a, veqodem sheyyukelu leqobro leachar hashshabbat yasriach, mah yaasu? Yiqberuhu beereb shabbat, dehaynu beyom tob rishon, al yede nokri, uleachar hashshabbat yotziuhu veyolikuhu lebet haqqebarot, o yannichuhu baaron beyom tob rishon, veyachmeruhu bachemar ubazzepet al yede nokri kede shello yasriach, ad leachar hashshabbat sheyyolikuhu lebet haqqebarot.
Kol melaka shehayyisrael asur lo laasotah beyom tob letzorek hammet — asur lo lomar laqqarai"m sheyyaaseh otah, mishshum "velipne ivver lo titten vego'".

Vekol zeh beyom tob rishon shehu min hattora, abal beyom tob sheni, apillu yom tob sheni shel rosh hashshana, kevan sheeno ella middibrehem — hare hu kechol leinyan qeburat hammet. Lepikak, apillu im met bo bayyom sheepshar lehashhoto ad haereb velo yasriach — en mashhin oto kelal, ella osin kol tzerakayv al yede yisrael, apillu debarim sheen tzarik leiqqar qeburato veen osin otan ella lehosip bikbodo, kegon lachtok lo hadas mehammechubbar, bimehem shehayu nohagin lehanniach hadas al mittato bishbil kebodo, veen tzarik lomar shechotzebin lo qeber, veosin lo aron vetakrikim, vegozezim searo. Veim en beotah hair meqom qebarot leyisrael — molikim oto leir acheret sheyyesh bah shekunat qebarot apillu chutz lattechum im yekolin lehaggia lesham uleqobro bo bayyom. Umaskirim lo sepina leholiko mimmaqom lemaqom, vaapillu epshar leqobro bimqomo, mikkol maqom, kevan sheen sham shekunat qibre yisrael — en zeh kebodo lehiqqaber sham.

Vaapillu epshar laasot kol debarim ellu al yede nokri — yitassequ bo yisrael, lepi shechakamim asauhu leyom tob sheni kechol leinyan qeburat hammet. Umikkol maqom, eno kechol gamur, ella hare hu kechullo shel moed sheasur laasot bo beparhesya dabar sheeno nikkar shehu letzorek hammet veyesh lachush lemarit haayin sheyyomru letzorko hu oseh, kegon lachtzob abanim kede libnot mehem qeber, veken leqatztzetz arazim kede laasot mehem aron, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqm"z. Abal muttar linsor nesarim min arazim haqqetzutzim meereb yom tob, shennikkar haddabar shekkede laasot mehen aron lemet hu menasseran, kevan shemmin hassetam yadua lekol bene hair sheyyesh met bair bimqomot hallalu sheen yehudim rabbim darim beir achat, ukesheyyesh met bair hu yadua lekol bene hair. Vaapillu beir sheddarim bah yehudim rabbim, im hammet hu adam mepursam shemmin hassetam hakkol yodeim bemitato, veshub en lachush lemarit haayin bedabar shennikkar shelletzorek hammet hu naaseh, kegon linsor nesarim im en lo nesarim mukanim qetannim, veliqtzotz hadas, velitpor takrikim im en lo takrikim mukanim, veim yesh lo takrikim mukanim ella shennittannepu vetzarik lekabbesan, veken laasot lo aron — kol debarim ellu vekayyotze bahem muttar laasot vaapillu beshuq beparhesya, kevan shehakkol yodeim sheyyesh met bair. Umikkol maqom, en lelek chutz lattechum bishbil shum dabar mitztzorke hammet, apillu kede lehabi lo takrikim unesarim laaron, vaapillu hu met mepursam, mikkol maqom bahalika zo en nikkar shelletzorek hammet hu holek chutz lattechum, veyesh lachush lemarit haayin, sheyyomru letzorko hu holek chutz lattechum.

Hakkippa shebbonim al haqqeber — en bonin otah beyom tob al yede yisrael apillu hu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, dekevan shenniqbar hammet baqqeber lamma yechallelu yom tob bechinnam shello letzorek kelal, ella yekassu haqqeber binsarim veapar. Umuttar litzbor heapar al gabbe haqqeber ad shennaaseh kemo tel, lepi sheggemar haqqebura hu zeh.

Vekol zeh meiqqar haddin, abal kebar nahagu bimdinot ellu lehachamir shello laasot al yede yisrael shum melaka gemura haasura min hattora, kegon lachpor lo qeber ulekassoto beapar achar shenniqbar uletaqqen aron vetakrikim, apillu beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot, kol sheepshar limtzo nokri sheyyaaseh otam. Abal lehachem lo mayim uletaharo ulehotzio ulesumo baqqeber — osin al yede yisrael, kemo shennitbaer lemala leinyan yom tob rishon. Veen nizharin letaharo beqash veteben kemo beyom tob rishon, ella metaharin oto bisdinim kedarkan bechol, kevan sheen kan ella gezera shemma yabou lide sechita, ubeyom tob sheni shehu middibrehem en chosheshin lekak, raq sheyyizzaharu shello yaasu sechita beyadayim. Veim i epshar limtzo nokrim sheyyitassequ bo, o sheyyitztarek lehamtin kamma shaot ad sheyyimmatzeu nokrim umittok kak yabo hammet lide bizzayon sheyyehe recho nodep — osin hakkol al yede yisrael apillu melakot gemurot, kemo shehu meiqqar haddin.

Vekol zeh kesherotzim leqobro bo bayyom, dekevan shehammitzva nigmeret bo bayyom asauhu chakamim kechol leinyan mitzva zo. Abal im lo yiqberu oto ad haereb — asur lechallel yom tob sheni apillu bedabar sheissuro eno ella middibre soperim letzorek mitzva hannaaset bechol, lepikak en motziim oto beyom tob sheni apillu lekarmelit apillu al yede nokri, veen mechimmin lo chammin kede letaharo apillu al yede nokri. Veap al pi shehotzaa vehabara hutteru apillu shello letzorek akila, mikkol maqom lo hutteru ella im ken yesh bahen tzorek hayyom qetzat, vekevan sheen meqabberim oto bo bayyom — en tzorek hayyom kelal. Abal letaltelo muttar ap al pi sheen meqabberin oto bo bayyom, kevan sheeno oseh bezeh shum melaka, raq tiltul beolma. Veyesh mi shemmachmir veoser gam letaltelo, kevan sheen meqabberin oto bo bayyom. Vetob lachush lidbarayv bedabar sheen bo hepsed kelal im en tzorek letaltelo. Veim yesh tzorek letaltelo, kegon mippene hakkohanim sheyyukelu likkanes labbayit o lishar tzorek — yetalteluhu al yede kikkar o tinoq, ap al pi sheen kikkar vetinoq moil lehattir tiltul hammet beshabbat letzorek hachayyim ella im ken hu letzorek hammet, kegon shehu muttal bachamma, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"a, mikkol maqom, kevan sheyyesh tzorek letaltelo — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, ki ken iqqar lahalaka.

Kol debarim hammuttarim laasot lemet beyom tob al yede yisrael — muttar lekol adam laasotan ap al pi sheeno mibbene hachabura hammeyuchedet lekak. Umuttar laasotan al yede anashim rabbim, ap al pi sheepshar laasotan al yede anashim muatim — en medaqdeqim bekak, kevan sheyyom tob sheni hu kechol leinyan qeburat met.
Dine qeriat shema utepilla im met lo met beyom tob rishon o beyom tob sheni — ayyen besimman a"a, ushear dine aninut — ayyen besimman tqm"ch ubeyoreh dea simman shm"a.

Keshemmeqabberin hammet beyom tob sheni utzerikim liqnot chatikat beged letakrikim — asur lehazkir sekum miqqach velo sekum maot (ayyen simman sh"v veshak"g), veen tzarik lomar sheasur litten lo maot beyom tob, ella im ken i epshar liqnot beinyan acher, kegon shehammoker hu poshea veeno rotzeh limkor beinyan acher, o shei epshar limtzo liqnot raq minnokri.

Veken im i epshar limtzo mi sheyyachpor lo qeber ella im ken yiqtzetzu lo sakar — muttar liqtzotz lo. Abal hachoper hu niqra poshea, shemmonea et atzmo mehammitzva ad sheyyiqtzetzu lo sakar beyom tob. Abal im en qotzetzin lo sakar beyom tob — yesh mi shemmattir lo leachar yom tob littol sekar torcho. Veap al pi sheasur littol sekar shabbat veyom tob shello bimqom mitzva, mikkol maqom bimqom mitzva yesh mi shemmattir, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"v. Laken en limchot beyad mi shemmeqel leatzmo, kemo shennitbaer sham.

Muttar lelavvot et hammet beyom tob rishon tok hattechum, ubeyom tob sheni apillu chutz lattechum, kevan shezzehu kebodo shel hammet, hare yom tob sheni nechshab kechol leinyan zeh. Apillu livvuhu kamma milin — muttarin lachazor limqoman bo bayyom, ap al pi shebbachazara zo en bah kebod hammet, mikkol maqom im lo yihyu muttarin lachazor limqoman — lo yelavvuhu kol kak, vimaatu bikbodo. Umittaam zeh muttarim haqqabberanim lehachazir immahem lebattehem et kol kele haqqebura sheholiku immahem chutz lattechum.

Hamlavvim et hammet asurim lirkob al gabbe behema velelek bispina, apillu tok hattechum, apillu beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot, ap al pi sheddebarim hallalu enan asurim ella middibre soperim, mikkol maqom yesh kan zilzul yom tob yoter mehalika baregel chutz lattechum, velo hittiru lezalzel bikbod yom tob kede lehosip uleharbot kebod hammet, shehare levaya zo enah meiqqar tzorke hammet, veenah ella kede leharbot bikbodo. Abal otan anashim hatztzerikim lehitasseq beiqqar tzorke qeburato, im yesh lahem tzaar lelek baregel o shehu torach gadol — muttarin beyom tob sheni lelek bispina o lirkob al gabbe behema, shehare yom zeh kechol hu leinyan qeburat hammet. Umikkol maqom, lo yirkebu betok hair o kepar sheyyesh bahen nokrim, shello yomru alehen shemmechallelin yom tob.

Im noda libne ir achat beyom tob sheni sheyyisrael met muttal al pene hassadeh bebizzayon rachoq mikkan mahalak arbaa o chamishsha yamim — muttarim bene hair latzet lederek bo bayyom kede lemaher qeburato. Ap al pi sheen mechallelin yom tob ella bishbil met sheyyiqqaber bo bayyom, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu muttal al pene hassadeh — yesh lachush shemma yokluhu kelabim qodem sheyyaggiu anshe hair lesham, velo yabo lide qebura kelal. Abal im hammet hu muttal bebayit hammishtammer, shebbevadday yabo lide qebura achar yom tob — asurin latzet beyom tob chutz lattechum kede lemaher qeburato achar yom tob.

Mi shemmet beir sheyyesh bah shekunat qebarot leyisrael, veqodem moto tzivva sheyyolikuhu leir acheret leqobro sham etzel qibre abotayv, ap al pi shemmitzva leqayyem dibre hammet, ubiprat bedabar shehu kebodo sheyyiqqaber etzel abotayv, mikkol maqom en zeh kebodo lechallel yom tob bechinnam, shehare im lo haya metzavveh al kaka — haya asur leholiko meir zo sheyyesh bah qibre yisrael leir acheret, nimtza shetztzavvaato goremet lechallel yom tob bishbilo, veen zeh kebodo, lepikak mashhin oto ad motzae yom tob umolikim oto leqibrot abotayv. Veim yesh lachush shemma yasriach veyabo lide bizzayon — meqabberin oto bimqomo beyom tob miyyad, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea besimman shs"g ayyen sham.

Tinoq shemmet betok sheloshim yom leledato, im gameru searo vetzippornayv, ap al pi sheen anu yodeim im kalu lo chodashayv — hare hu bechezqat ben qayyama, umeqabberim oto beyom tob rishon al yede nokri, ubeyom tob sheni al yede yisrael, lepi sherob hannashim yoledot valad shel qayyama, umin hassetam kalu lo chodashayv. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmet leachar hammila, o shehi neqeba, abal tinoq shemmat qodem milato, apillu met beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot — en leqobro bo bayyom, lepi shetztzarik lehasir orlato bitzror o beeben qodem sheyyiqberuhu kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman rs"g, ubeyom tob asur lehasir haorla, lepi sheddabar zeh eno mitztzorke haqqebura, vegam eno bishbil kebod hattinoq kelal shennechallel yom tob sheni bishbil kak, ella hu mittaam shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham.

Veim lo gameru searo vetzippornayv, o sheyyadua shello kalu lo chodashayv — en meqabberin oto apillu al yede nokri, apillu hu yom tob sheni shel galuyyot, apillu hi neqeba, dekol shehavvalad eno ben qayyama en sham bizzayon kelal im mashhin oto ad haereb.
Ap al pi sheyyom tob sheni hu kechol leinyan isqe hammet, ap al pi ken en qerobim qoreim bigdehem ad haereb, lepi sheddabar zeh eno meisqe hammet, ella chobat hachayyim hi.

Keshemmet belel yom tob sheni — mashkimin lemachar umeqabberim oto qodem tepillat shacharit. Veim i epshar lehaqdim kol kak o shemmet ezo shaot al hayyom shel yom tob sheni — meqabberin oto beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur omer piyyutim ushear debarim sheen choba al hakkol leomram uleshomam. Vetob leqabbetz minyan bishat haqqebura. Veim hammet hu adam chashub shetztzerikim rabbim lelavvoto — yotziuhu lebet haqqebarot achar yetzia mibbet hakkeneset, kede sheyyelavvuhu rabbim, vechozerim hamlavvin lebattehem leekol seuddat yom tob, veachar haakila meqabberim oto karauy, ayyen simman tm"g hattaam lekol zeh. (Din tzidduq haddin beyom tob rishon ubeyom tob sheni — ayyen beyoreh dea simman t"a uleel simman t"k).
